top_signals.title: BOJ Inflation Target Signal Supports Yen Gains, Strategists Say
top_signals.summary: The yen broadly held its gains after the Bank of Japan left its benchmark rate unchanged in an 8-1 vote, while signaling underlying inflation had reached its 2% target and opening the door to a December hike. The BOJ also accelerated the pace of ETF sales to about ¥860 billion ($5.5 billion) a year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Taiwan Stocks Heads for Correction as Global AI Selloff Deepens
top_signals.summary: Taiwan’s stock benchmark is on the verge of entering into a technical correction as the global selloff in artificial intelligence stocks deepens.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Copper Declines as Tech Selloff, Oil Rally Dent Risk Appetite
top_signals.summary: Copper slipped on the London Metal Exchange as a selloff of technology stocks and higher oil prices fueled concerns about global growth.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Chinese Junk Dollar Bonds Head for Worst Week in a Year on Huafa
top_signals.summary: China’s high-yield dollar bonds are heading for their worst week in more than a year as signs of liquidity strains at state-owned conglomerate Zhuhai Huafa Group Co. sapped sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
